hero.sub: A neighborhood where distinctive homes, outdoor living and genuine connection come together.

experience.lead: A thoughtfully designed neighborhood where distinctive homes, outdoor living, everyday convenience and genuine connection come together.

pilares.texto: Shared spaces placed where neighborhood life naturally happens.
Food, coffee and daily essentials always just around the corner.
Varied architecture and streetscapes with real character.
Private yards, plunge pools and room to actually be outside.

howitworks.lead: Huddle brings homes, food, recreation, technology and connection together in one expertly designed place.

pasos.texto: Distinctive townhomes, smart-home living and private outdoor space.
Cool Eats, community Wi-Fi and everyday connection.

spin.lead: One full turn around the homes. Drag the view or use the arrows to see how the houses, the yards and the pools sit together.

amenities.lead: Each one is designed to make everyday life easier, more social and more distinctly Huddle.
amenities.nota: Designed to move. Gather. Play. Belong.

experiencias.texto: A landscaped route connecting homes, shared spaces and daily movement.
Community-wide Wi-Fi keeps residents connected at home and throughout the neighborhood.
Food, coffee and everyday connection are always just around the corner.

experiencias.titulo: Cart to Coffee. Cart to Dinner.
experiencias.texto: Golf-cart access makes getting around Huddle convenient, and a little more fun.
Every home can add an 8′ × 10′ plunge pool, a private backyard retreat without leaving the neighborhood.
A Wi-Fi enabled outdoor living room and a natural place to meet neighbors without having to host at home.
The Pickleball Commons builds movement, fun, wellness and friendship into neighborhood life.

block360.lead: A full turn around Huddle from the air. Drag the view or use the arrows to see how the homes, the trail, the Pickleball Commons and the Quiet Lawn sit together.

homes.lead: 48 townhomes designed to create a neighborhood with rhythm, variety and character.

homesDatos.texto: Varied exterior colors, distinctive elevations and tall rooflines.
Integrated smart-home features throughout every home.
Fenced outdoor spaces with optional 8′ × 10′ plunge pools.

gallery.lead: Exteriors, aerials and the first interiors. Tap any image to open it full size.

video.lead: A short film through the neighborhood: the homes, the shared spaces and the way the whole place fits together.

tour.lead: Drag to look around and use the floor points to move between spaces. Runs in the browser, nothing to install.

timeline.lead: Huddle gives the 2027 Dream Home Neighborhood campaign a clear runway, from presales through completed homes.

hitos.texto: Marketing launches alongside buyer outreach, creating a full runway for the campaign.
Construction updates, interviews, site access and digital storytelling build momentum.
A tangible neighborhood milestone aligned with the 2027 program.

contact.parrafo1: Tell us what you would like to know and we will get back to you with details, availability and next steps.
contact.parrafo2: Together, we can show what it means to live connected.

plans.lead: Two floors per home, four homes per building. Every unit has its own garage, a covered lanai and the option of a plunge pool in the backyard.
plans.nota: Plans are illustrative. Dimensions and finishes may vary by homesite.
plans.resumen: 3 bedrooms  ·  2.5 baths  ·  2-car garage  ·  covered lanai and balcony

patio.lead: Every home comes with a fenced backyard, and an 8′ × 10′ plunge pool is optional. Drag the handle to see the same backyard both ways.
patio.altAntes: Backyard with a lawn, without a plunge pool
patio.altDespues: The same backyard with an 8 by 10 foot plunge pool
